newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Consumer confidence still a worry for wool - WI.
newsitem.headline: Consumer confidence still a worry for wool - WI.

text.p: Weak consumer confidence in many wool consuming countries remained a concern, Wool International (WI) said in its July Insight publication.
Nevertheless, demand should improve for wool in 1997/98 as more synchronised growth encouraged demand, it said.
The extent of the recovery would largely depend on Northern Hemisphere autumn/winter retail demand, it said.
High woolgrower stocks could flow onto the market at around current price levels, limiting further significant price increases over the next six months, it said.
During the current September quarter, WI, which manages the selldown of Australia's wool stockpile, would progressively focus sales activity into the December 1997 quarter, it said.
However, sales would also continue to be made in the current quarter where demand remained strong, it said.
